original_benchmark.notes: DistDebug-Bench Lite (benchmark/lite.txt, v1.1 labels, upstream commit c3e929b). Scored by deterministic comparison with human-labeled root-cause blocks; block_coverage is the main metric.
Generation is implemented (--split full, all 120 snapshots pinned); oracle 120/120 at reward 1.0 on local Docker. The registry dataset targets Lite.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity matched (range overlap on all upstream metrics) with mini-swe-agent@2.2.8 + StepFun step-5-preview via the Step Plan subscription (no per-token charge, hence $0); 12-bug parity split = 10% of the 120-bug benchmark, 3 runs per side. Reward = block_coverage; all upstream metrics are also reported in reward.json.
